events.label: founding
events.text: Klemzig founded by German emigrants on land offered by Angas.

evidence.quote: In 1838 , Klemzig was founded by these emigrants

events.text: First Old Lutheran emigrant groups began arriving at Port Misery.
Arrivals of first Old Lutheran emigrant groups at Port Misery ended.
Klemzig renamed Gaza during anti-German sentiment in WWI.
Klemzig name reinstated under South Australia Nomenclature Act 1935.

evidence.quote: Klemzig was re-instated as the suburb name with the enactment of the South Australia Nomenclature Act of 1935 on 12 December 1935

undated_mentions: Residents petitioned the South Australian Government to reinstate the name Gaza during World War II; requests were denied.
